record.original_question: Does there exist a natural number K such that every K-arc-strong digraph D=(V,A) can be decomposed into two arc-disjoint strong spanning subdigraphs D1=(V,A1) and D2=(V,A2)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.5 (Bang-Jensen and Yeo, 2004). There exists a natural number K such that every K-arc-strong digraph D = (V, A) can be decomposed into two arc-disjoint strong spanning subdigraphs D1 = (V, A1) and D2 = (V, A2).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A directed graph (digraph) D=(V,A) is called strong (or strongly connected) if for every ordered pair of distinct vertices u,v ∈ V there exists a directed path from u to v in D. For a positive integer k, D is called k-arc-strong if |V|≥2 and for every set F ⊆ A with |F| ≤ k−1 the digraph (V, A∖F) is strong; equivalently, every directed cut of D has at least k arcs.

A spanning subdigraph of D is a digraph of the form (V, A') with A' ⊆ A. Two spanning subdigraphs (V, A_1) and (V, A_2) are called arc-disjoint if A_1 ∩ A_2 = ∅. We say that D admits a decomposition into two arc-disjoint strong spanning subdigraphs if there exist A_1, A_2 ⊆ A with A_1 ∩ A_2 = ∅ such that both (V, A_1) and (V, A_2) are strong.

Question: Does there exist a natural number K (independent of D) such that every K-arc-strong digraph D=(V,A) admits a decomposition into two arc-disjoint strong spanning subdigraphs?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture, due to Bang-Jensen and Yeo (2004), remains open in general. Partial results exist: it has been verified for 2-arc-strong semicomplete digraphs (with one exception on 4 vertices), for semicomplete compositions, for tournaments with sufficiently large minimum semi-degree, and for various structured classes such as split digraphs, but no universal constant K is known to suffice for all digraphs.

status_evidence.title: Decomposing k-arc-strong tournament into k spanning strong digraphs
status_evidence.snippet: Bang-Jensen and Yeo conjectured that there is some K such that every K-arc-strong digraph has a strong arc decomposition.
status_evidence.claim: The general conjecture remains an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Arc-disjoint Strong Spanning Subdigraphs of Semicomplete Compositions
status_evidence.snippet: Partial results obtained for semicomplete compositions.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture verified for further structured classes; general case remains open.

status_evidence.title: Strong arc decompositions of split digraphs
status_evidence.claim: Continued partial progress; the general conjecture is still unresolved.
